title: Pro-zero middle terms in inverse systems of distinguished triangles
statement: Let $\mathcal D$ be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category]. For each $n\geq1$ let $A_n\to B_n\to C_n\to A_n[1]$ be a distinguished triangle, and for every $k\geq n$ let the three maps to level $n$ form a morphism of distinguished triangles (so these triangles and maps are an inverse system [def-weil-inverse-system]). Assume that for every $n$ there is $k\geq n$ such that both maps $A_k\to A_n$ and $C_k\to C_n$ are zero. Then for every $n$ there is $k\geq n$ such that the map $B_k\to B_n$ is zero.

source.place: Tag 0G3A (lemma-essentially-constant-2-out-of-3), specialized to essentially zero systems (zero-valued case)

proof.text: Fix $n\geq1$. Write $u_i:A_i\to B_i$ and $v_i:B_i\to C_i$ for the triangle arrows, and $a_{j,i},b_{j,i},c_{j,i}$ for the transition maps. By the hypothesis at level $n$, choose $m\geq n$ with $a_{m,n}=0$ (and $c_{m,n}=0$, although the latter is not needed). The triangle-morphism equation gives $b_{m,n}\circ u_m=u_n\circ a_{m,n}=0$.

source.place: Tag 0G3A (lemma-essentially-constant-2-out-of-3), zero-valued specialization; direct factorization using Tag 0149 (lemma-representable-homological)

proof.text: Apply clause (i) of [lem-weil-pbc-hom-out-of-triangle-exact] to the distinguished triangle at level $m$, with $W=B_n$ and $a=b_{m,n}$. Step 1 verifies exactly its vanishing hypothesis. It supplies $h:C_m\to B_n$ such that $b_{m,n}=h\circ v_m$.

source.place: Tag 0G3A (lemma-essentially-constant-2-out-of-3), zero-valued specialization; direct factorization using Tag 0149 (lemma-representable-homological)

proof.text: Apply the pro-zero hypothesis at level $m$ to choose $k\geq m$ with $c_{k,m}=0$ (and $a_{k,m}=0$). The triangle-morphism equation is $v_m\circ b_{k,m}=c_{k,m}\circ v_k$. The inverse-system composition law therefore yields $b_{k,n}=b_{m,n}\circ b_{k,m}=h\circ v_m\circ b_{k,m}=h\circ c_{k,m}\circ v_k=0$.

source.place: Tag 0G3A (lemma-essentially-constant-2-out-of-3), zero-valued specialization; direct factorization using Tag 0149 (lemma-representable-homological)

proof.text: Since $k\geq m\geq n$, Step 3 supplies a zero transition $B_k\to B_n$ at the initially chosen level. This construction works for every $n\geq1$, proving the asserted pro-zero property.
